question: What is AWS App Mesh?
answer: AWS App Mesh is a service mesh that standardizes service communication, providing end-to-end visibility and network traffic controls for applications.

course_context.usage: Teams use AWS App Mesh to monitor and control service communication in cloud applications.

workflow: Deploy network proxies alongside application code
Define a service mesh as a logical boundary
Create virtual services as abstractions of actual services
Configure virtual nodes as pointers to discoverable services
Set up virtual routers to handle traffic
Define routes to distribute traffic among virtual nodes
devops_application: DevOps teams use AWS App Mesh to manage service-to-service communication and ensure high availability of applications.
